summary: A 1966 CDF-plan cab on Blue Mountain in Calaveras County that replaced a 1934 CCC lookout; CAL FIRE operates it and access is restricted.

facts.design: Single-story CDF Plan 809RA cab, a variation of the 809R plans

access.note: The register says the station is 16 miles from paved road and access is restricted (note marked 10/91). CAL FIRE operates the lookout and does not rent its lookouts.

events.note: First permanent lookout, built from wood from the first Calaveras Ranger Station
Forest Service leased one acre on Blue Mountain for a fire lookout and supply station
Civilian Conservation Corps built the second lookout
Current cab built, based on CDF plan 809RA; replaced a CCC-era lookout
Registered April 24, 2017; nominated by Bill Luedeke

notes_for_editor: Agency conflict: the record and the register name the U.S. Forest Service as administrator, while the register text and ALERTCalifornia say CAL FIRE operates the lookout. Both are stated in the story. The ALERTCalifornia post's 1966 CCC era wording conflicts with the register's 1934 CCC date; the register is followed. The CAL FIRE fact sheet is undated (CDN link). The access note is dated 1991. No staffing record or fire history for this lookout beyond the 1920s newspaper items. Living New Deal (CCC context) returned 403 and was not used. The NHLR photos are all rights reserved, so none were added.
